scope: Defines who sees / can do what across the 6 Studio OS sections, with explicit operator vs tenant capability table and the enforcement mechanism for each gate.

host_resolution.tenant_resolved_from: request.school (NEVER from POST body / query string)

capabilities: theme + experience packs for own school

operator_sees: all 8 mission-signal tiles including cross-tenant counts (when overview_signals real values land)
operator-only RBAC + feature-control chips in hub rail (--operator chip variant)
tenant_sees: 6 of 8 mission-signal tiles (Pending launches / Draft experiences / Active automations / Output readiness % / Open blockers / Mode indicator)
shared: mode card grid (5 cards routing to each section)
overview.enforcement: Template-level: {% if request.public_host_kind == 'manager' %} gate in overview_command_cockpit.html lines 179-190.

experience.enforcement: View-level: apps/siteconfig/views.py::theme_colors gates by tenant; apps/studio_os/views.py::studio_experience_compare scopes to request.school.

automation.enforcement: Template-level: data-rmc-confirm attribute on destructive buttons → shared studio_os__shell.js handler. View-level: apps/studio_os/views.py automation views scope by tenant.

output.money_format_rule: Use Decimal helpers (apps.finance.json_decimal.amount_str) — NEVER float() per scan_money_float baseline 0
output.enforcement: Template-level: tenant-scoped iframe sources for documents/builder.

tenant_sees: own school plan selection (read-only until approval)
approval_required: infrastructure apply (operator data-rmc-confirm gated; tenant request triggers operator approval workflow)
launch.money_format_rule: Plan pricing uses Decimal helpers; no float() — current select-plan body uses honest 'Coming soon' state per Agent 5 audit
launch.enforcement: Template-level: launch_school_infrastructure_body operator-only Apply button gated by {% if request.public_host_kind == 'manager' %} + perm check + data-rmc-confirm. View-level: school_infrastructure_apply_api returns 501 in current state (intentional — counsel docket; per memory).

tenant_sees: feature flag READS for own school
audit_required: all rollback/cleanup/config changes — emit audit-log entries
control.pii_safety: Audit entries render actor_display (hashed prefix OR displayed_name) — NEVER raw actor_email / _username / _slug. Same pattern as Migration Cloud audit log per CLAUDE.md.
control.enforcement: View-level: studio_audit_api / studio_rollback / studio_ai_cleanup scope by user and tenant. Template-level: data-rmc-confirm + {% if perms.X %} gate on destructive buttons. shell.html control branch renders e.actor_display (PII-safe).

tenant_safety_invariants: Tenant cannot see another tenant's previews / data — preview routes scope to request.school via tenant middleware.
Tenant cannot perform platform-level mutations — gated by request.public_host_kind == 'manager' OR @staff_member_required.
Operator cannot accidentally bleed cross-tenant audit data into tenant views — audit list filters by request.school for tenant users.
PII (email/username/slug) never rendered raw in audit lists — actor_display field used instead.
Destructive actions require data-rmc-confirm AND permission check — both gates must pass.
Role names come from apps.platform_runtime.role_registry / User.Role TextChoices — never hardcoded string literals (scan_role_strings baseline 268 holds).
AI guidance does not leak operator internals into tenant context (school slug → sha256[:8] in all logs/payloads per batch 1372 R2).

javascript: capture-phase data-rmc-confirm handler in studio_os__shell.js — runs BEFORE native handlers so cancellation stops destructive actions

honest_deferrals: operator_school resolution UI exists (studio_os:set_operator_school) — coordinator did not audit this wave
tenant role-preview routes per audience (Admin/Teacher/Parent/Student) use existing studio_role_preview_entries shape — real per-audience preview routes are a v3.55+ wave
automation tenant-scoped approval workflow real implementation deferred — cockpit shows honest 'no automations queued' empty state
